strategyFamily: source-qualified causal funding-regime carry with high collateral and deterministic re-anchoring
motivation: Trial 23 passed every development gate but was inactive in the one-shot 2026 final at its frozen 15% annualized entry hurdle. Trial 24 is a new, explicitly adaptive trial that tests a cost-break-even 10% entry hurdle on a different source-qualified ETH/BNB derivative information set; Trial 23 remains locked as a final no-go.

assetSelection.rule: Use exactly ETH and BNB because earlier carry trials source-qualified their complete 2022-2025 development inputs before another asset blocked each trial; neither earlier trial reached ETH/BNB carry economics or acquired this Trial 24 2026 final window.

portfolio.position: long spot and short equal coin units of matching Binance USD-M perpetual when active

signal.causality: At boundary t use exactly the previous 90 realized funding rates through t-1; exclude current-boundary funding from the decision. Existing positions receive current-boundary funding before an exit or re-anchor; new entries do not receive entry-boundary funding.
signal.thresholdRationale: Under the frozen venue-native cost model, approximate two-leg round-trip friction on a 15%-notional hedge is about 0.12% of sleeve equity. Ten percent annualized funding on 15% notional earns about 0.123% over the 30-day minimum state. This cost-break-even rationale was fixed without querying Trial 24 ETH/BNB funding values.

riskControl.reanchorAction: If funding exit has not triggered, close and immediately reopen at full modeled costs after 180 active boundaries or when perpetual mark notional reaches 25% of current sleeve equity, using then-current sleeve equity for frozen 15% spot / 80% collateral sizing.
riskControl.realizedMarginOrdering: Test current observed isolated-margin maintenance before any exit/re-anchor; retained post-decision positions receive hypothetical gap stresses.

costModel.inheritance: Inherited from pre-existing frozen Trial 20 cost assumptions.

finalHoldout.accessRule: No Trial 24 final derivative/funding row may be acquired unless every frozen development criterion passes.

antiRescueRule: After first Trial 24 development economic output, no scientific parameter or gate may change under Trial 24.
